description: What the trader's own words DID - never whether they turned out to be right. TJ-16 item 4: the nightly tagger reads `mentor.observation` (What I see) and `mentor.prediction.because` (Because), and labels each with codes from this closed list, every code carrying the exact span it was read from. The model never sees a verdict, a grade, a price or a bar while tagging, so a tag can never be derived from the outcome. Codes are permanent identifiers: a code is never renamed and never reused for a different meaning, because rows already written carry it, and a later vocabulary ships as observation_tags_v2.json beside this file. These codes become point-in-time context fields for the NEXT prediction contrast, so each one describes the REASONING, not the market and not the result.

tags.label: Cites a level
tags.hint: Names a specific price, moving average, band, VWAP, prior high or low - something on the chart with a number behind it.

tags.label: Cites volatility
tags.hint: Talks about range, ATR, how fast or how choppy the tape is, or volatility coming in or going out.

tags.label: Cites news or an event
tags.hint: Names an earnings report, an economic print, a headline, a Fed event or any scheduled catalyst.

tags.label: Cites breadth or sectors
tags.hint: Talks about how many names are participating, or about a sector or group leading or lagging.

tags.label: Cites the D1 picture
tags.hint: Refers to the daily chart, the swing structure, the trend of the last few sessions, or the desk's D1 environment.

tags.label: Cites volume or liquidity
tags.hint: Talks about volume, relative volume, thin or heavy trade, or how easy the name is to get out of.

tags.label: Cites the internals
tags.hint: Refers to session VWAP position, the prior session's range, the gap, or another desk internals reading.

tags.label: Hedged wording
tags.hint: Softens the call in the words themselves - 'maybe', 'probably', 'if it holds', 'could go either way'.

tags.label: Reacting to the last bar
tags.hint: The reason given is what just happened in the last few minutes rather than anything that was true before it.

tags.label: Cites a previous call
tags.hint: Refers back to an earlier read of their own - staying with it, changing it, or answering it.

tags.label: No reason given
tags.hint: The words state a view and nothing that supports it. Quote the words that stand in place of a reason - 'gut', 'feels heavy', 'just does not look right'.
